scripts.dev: pnpm run build && dotenv --no-expand -- pnpm run start
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm run build && node --env-file=.env --import reflect-metadata dist/database/cli.js up
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dfragon/lib build && node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --import reflect-metadata --test ".test-dist/test/**/*.test.js" test-support/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:database: pnpm run build && node --import reflect-metadata test-support/database-integration.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:up: pnpm run build && node --import reflect-metadata dist/database/cli.js up
scripts.db:migrate:down: pnpm run build && node --import reflect-metadata dist/database/cli.js down
scripts.db:migrate:show: pnpm run build && node --import reflect-metadata dist/database/cli.js show
scripts.db:migrate:generate: pnpm run build && node --import reflect-metadata dist/database/generate-cli.js
